# openmetadata_spreadsheet (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata spreadsheet by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_spreadsheet" "revenue" {
  fully_qualified_name = "google-drive.reports.quarterly-revenue"
}

output "revenue_spreadsheet_parent" {
  value = data.openmetadata_spreadsheet.revenue.parent
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Spreadsheet fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Spreadsheet UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Spreadsheet name.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the containing directory, when there is one.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent drive service.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
